scholarships.title: RISE (Research Internships in Science and Engineering) Germany

scholarships.title: DAAD Masters’ Study Scholarships

scholarships.title: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
scholarships.description: This scholarship programme offers the opportunity to continue academic education in Germany with a postgraduate course of study. The programme provides funding for a whole postgraduate or Master's degree programme at a state or state-recognised university in Germany, or one year of study in Germany as part of a Master's degree completed at a home university.

scholarships.title: Study Visits for Academics - Artists and Architects

scholarships.title: Study Scholarships - Master Studies for All Academic Disciplines
scholarships.description: DAAD scholarships for graduates with a first academic degree wishing to continue their academic training in Germany with a postgraduate course of study.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are prestigious international master's programmes, jointly designed and delivered by a group of higher education institutions. scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are high-level and integrated study programmes at the master level, designed and delivered by an international partnership of higher education institutions. scholarships.title: Chevening SIDS Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Chevening SIDS Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from Small Island Developing States (SIDS) to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK. scholarships.title: Chevening SIDS Scholarship

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship

scholarships.title: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
scholarships.description: The ASEAN Chevening Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master’s degree in the UK.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships

scholarships.description: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships are for candidates from eligible lower and upper middle income Commonwealth countries, to undertake full-time taught Master’s study at a UK university. Funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO).

scholarships.title: Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Master’s Scholarships enable talented and motivated individuals to gain the knowledge and skills required for sustainable development. Candidates are nominated for this award through a nominating agency.

scholarships.title: CSC Research Impact Awards

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Professional Fellowships

scholarships.title: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: Commonwealth PhD Scholarships are for applicants from least developed countries and vulnerable states, as classified by the OECD Development Assistance Committee (DAC), in the Commonwealth, for full-time doctoral study at a UK university.

scholarships.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
scholarships.description: The Commonwealth Shared Scholarship programme provides Master’s level funding for students from Least Developed and middle-income Commonwealth countries who would not otherwise be able to afford to study in the UK. scholarships.title: Commonwealth Master’s Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)

scholarships.title: Rhodes Scholarship

scholarships.description: The Swedish Institute (SI) offers fully funded scholarships for master's level studies in Sweden. The program includes 'Global Professionals' for those aiming to advance sustainable growth and societal change, and 'Pioneering Women in STEM' to empower women in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. scholarships.title: SI Scholarship for Global Professionals
scholarships.description: The SI Scholarship for Global Professionals is a fully-funded scholarship for master’s studies in Sweden. It covers full tuition fees, a monthly living allowance of SEK 12,000, and a travel grant, while providing access to the SI Network for Global Professionals.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program
scholarships.description: The France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program is a tool developed by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their master's and doctoral programs.

scholarships.title: France Excellence Eiffel scholarship program

scholarships.description: The Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Program was established by the French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs to enable French higher education institutions to attract top foreign students to enroll in their masters and PhD programs. fields: Human, animal and ecosystem health (One Health)
scholarships.description: The Make Our Planet Great Again (MOPGA) 2025 visiting fellowship program supports early career researchers (holding a doctoral degree for less than 5 years) to carry out research in France on climate change and environmental issues.

scholarships.title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES) programme supports high-calibre international students who wish to study at master’s, postgraduate diploma or PhD levels in Ireland. The scholarship consists of a €10,000 stipend for one year of full-time study and a full fee waiver from the host higher education institution.

scholarships.title: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) Grant
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) is Ireland’s single national awarding authority for all higher and further education grants. It offers funding to eligible students in approved full-time third-level education in Ireland and, in some cases, for students studying outside of Ireland.

scholarships.title: Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD)
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Fund for Students with Disabilities (FSD) assists higher education institutions in ensuring students with disabilities have the necessary assistance and equipment to access, participate in, and complete their chosen course of study. Funding is provided to the institution, not directly to the student.

scholarships.title: Student Assistance Fund
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Student Assistance Fund provides financial support to full or part-time students who are experiencing financial difficulties while attending college. It is designed to provide a source of financial support in addition to a SUSI grant to help with costs such as books, class materials, rent, utility bills, food, travel, childcare, and medical costs.

scholarships.title: Back to Education Allowance
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Back to Education Allowance (BTEA) allows people who are unemployed, parenting alone, or have a disability and are receiving certain payments from the Department of Social Protection to take part in second- or third-level education courses while continuing to receive support.

scholarships.title: Free Fees Initiative
scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Free Fees Initiative provides funding for tuition fees for eligible full-time undergraduate students undertaking approved courses in participating higher education institutions in Ireland. Students must meet specific nationality and residency requirements (ordinarily resident in an EU/EEA/Swiss State/UK for at least three of the five years preceding entry). Note that eligible students are still required to pay a student contribution charge.

scholarships.source: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: SUSI (Student Universal Support Ireland) funding is available for students to pursue postgraduate courses in approved institutions. The page also references tax relief available on postgraduate tuition fees.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships

scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are offered by the New Zealand Government for international students to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study. scholarships.title: Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships

scholarships.title: English Language Training for Officials Scholarships

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are awarded to citizens from eligible developing countries to undertake study in New Zealand or the Pacific. scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide opportunities for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study in New Zealand.
